lessons.observation: Posts featuring real logic analyzer traces showing timing jitter received 4x more comments from staff engineers than posts merely discussing the theoretical protocol.
lessons.actionable_rule: Always pair protocol or bus debugging posts with an annotated oscilloscope or logic analyzer capture.

lessons.observation: Highlighting edge-case failure modes and how the deterministic guardrail recovered the system drove 3 inbound collaboration inquiries from founders.
lessons.actionable_rule: Emphasize failure mitigation and error budgets over simplistic 'happy path' demos.
